notes:
Zone roads: Normal Avenue from x -560 (west edge of the ortho and LiDAR) to a straight cut at x -300, and Carlisle Road from Normal Avenue north to y -58, plus the two-track grade crossing at x -447..-437.
Frame: Normal Ave was read in a straightened frame along the axis through (-544.9, -200.5) at -13.84 deg (u along, v left/north). Carriageway edges are straight runs in that frame; the plan stores model x, y.
Normal Ave: south curb v -5.0 over the whole length (clear 0.1-0.15 m step in the LiDAR ground, lidar2017, and the asphalt/grass edge in ortho2020). North curb v +5.6 west of Carlisle (ortho: concrete walk 5.7-7.2 directly behind the curb; LiDAR step), so 10.6 m curb to curb. East of Carlisle the north curb is at v 8.8 (right-turn lane, 13.8 m wide) and tapers to v 5.3 between u 178 and 214 (x -372 to -337), then v 5.1 at x -300 (10.1 m). The taper is straight runs with 40 m arcs.
Raised concrete medians (LiDAR +0.16 m, light in the ortho, island visible in subwaynut_montclair_heights20.jpg) at v -1.2..+0.3 from x -481 to -447.5 (west of the tracks) and x -436 to -420.6 (east); beyond -420.6 the ortho shows only paint.
Grade crossing: track centres from OSM (-445.2,-225.5) and (-440.1,-226.8); rails and panels are not resolved in the 0.15 m ortho, so the 2.6 m concrete panels are UNVERIFIED. Masts from isolated vertical LiDAR columns: NE (6.7 m) and SW (5.1 m) gate masts with flashers and crossbucks (photo); SE 5.7 m exit gate (photo, direction of view unknown); NW 5.8 m gate guessed from height; 3.0-3.3 m posts on both median noses are signs (photo).
Carlisle Road: centre double yellow read from the ortho (yellowness profile) and checked against msu_sprague_DJI_20250530101718_0163_D.jpg, which shows a double yellow, one northbound lane by the hedge and two southbound lanes with white dashes. Curb to curb about 11.7 m at y -125 (west curb -414.8, east curb at the hedge, CL + 3.9 m), about 11 m at the junction (west curb -412.6, east curb CL + 3.9). East curb follows the centre line +3.9 m the whole way (bright curb line in the ortho, LiDAR step). West curb north of y -110 is under tree cover and is UNVERIFIED; north of y -88 the lot entrance opens on the east side and the ring is cut straight at y -58.
Junction corners: NW radius 7 m, NE radius 8 m, from the LiDAR slope map and the ortho walks.
Markings from ortho2020: Normal Ave double yellow (faint west of the medians), westbound right-turn lane line at v 4.2, westbound stop bar before Carlisle (x -391), westbound stop bar before the tracks (x -432), two crosswalks across Normal Ave (slanted pair east of Carlisle at x -403..-395, pair at x -420.3 and -417.2 west of it), Carlisle stop bar at y -221.5 and one line across its mouth. Added later, read in frames along each road: two westbound left-turn arrows at the west end, two right-turn arrows in the westbound turn lane east of Carlisle, the RXR symbol (X, R letters, a 0.6 m transverse bar) in the westbound through lane, the solid lane line between Carlisle's two southbound lanes and their arrows (left turn in the east lane, through-and-right in the west lane). Arrows are drawn at the FHWA sizes. Not drawn: box-shaped marks 4.5 m before the Carlisle left arrows (perhaps ONLY; not legible), the Upper Mountain Ave stop bar just west of x -560, and an eastbound stop bar west of the tracks (not visible).
Points: utility poles and lamps are isolated vertical LiDAR columns; heights are the highest return above ground. Lamp kinds are guessed from height.
Station lot entrance (x -414..-402 south side) and the lot entrance at x -315..-307 north side: the ring edge runs straight across; curbs stop there.
Sidewalks: north walk 1.5 m directly behind the curb west of Carlisle and 1.7 m east of it; a short station-side walk south of the road east of the tracks; Carlisle east walk (tapered, y -158..-196) between the curb and the stand.
